lastUpdated.patchNote: Not on the changed-units shortlist — no patch signal contradicts this guidance, but it was not re-verified after the patch (governing sources predate it).

doctrines.note: Veterancy: +11 points bottom, rest TOP LINE (confirmed in a 2025-05-29 follow-up screenshot: top line 3/3, 3/3, 2/2, 3/3, 2/3, 0/3; bottom line 3/3, 3/3, 0/3, 0/3, 0/2 — exact icon-to-ability mapping not labeled in thread). Hero pairing: Any. Example build: Health & Resistance Doctrine, Unit Damage Doctrine V, Epic Combat Doctrine (3/6/9), Hero Damage Doctrine V, Epic Leadership Doctrine. Rotation: X-move in; press 1 (Sideways Sweep); when 1's CD shows 11s remaining, press 2 (Deathstrike); when 2's CD shows 24s remaining, press 3 (Get Over Here); press 1 again when up; repeat the 11s-remaining trigger for 3. Never cancel 1/2 before their 6s duration finishes; avoid Cover Commander when you can simply disengage and wait out cooldowns. Patch-note mechanics (8/15/2024, carried in OP): Sideways Sweep and Deathstrike reduce damage taken 40% for 3s and remove control effects instantly, and increase attack rate for their duration; their damage (incl. Deathstrike released under Get Over Here) +30%; Deathstrike minimum damage rate 0.1->0.2; Deathstrike deals extra damage to charging enemies; basic attacks hit +1 enemy. "Don't put" is a literal X placeholder in the OP — not fabricated here. GAP: a follow-up image (2025-05-29) shows the veterancy point allocation as in-game icons without a labeled icon-to-ability mapping — do not invent which ability each icon slot corresponds to; treat the exact allocation as unconfirmed beyond the '+11 bottom, rest top' summary line. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset — Silahdars is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).

entries.text: Cavalry and instant-burst units like Claymores.
High-DR/Spartan-meta comps in blob or sustained fights.

steps.text: Spells last 6s and grant CCi plus 40% damage reduction for 3s after — rotate accordingly; stay in CC during downtime, go in/out depending on enemy burst and your front.

X-move in; press 1 (Sideways Sweep); at 11s left on 1's CD press 2 (Deathstrike); at 24s left on 2's CD press 3 (Get Over Here); repeat 1, then repeat the 11s-trigger for 3. Never cancel 1/2 before their 6s duration.
Better against Spartan-meta (high DR/blob/sustained); worse against Reapers, 1v1, and other burst-oriented matchups (per Amya's 2025-05-29 follow-up).
